claude.performance_metric: Net income available to common fell from $6,311M (2021) to $589M (2023); ~2,000-employee reduction under 2023 Restructuring Program
claude.rationale: The slice documents a financial decline (net income $6,311M in 2021 to $589M in 2023) and a Board-approved 2023 Restructuring Program with ~2,000 job cuts framed as a response to "the continued economic impact from the global recessionary environment," not to any product/operations misalignment or operations/people fracture arising from the deal. No line describes an acquired product failing to align with operating processes (p4=0) or operations breaking against the organization/culture (p5=0). The restructuring is attributed to macroeconomic conditions and cost improvement, and the registrant continued as an independent SEC-reporting company throughout the window with no documented archetype incoherence or business-model incompatibility.
